name: affiliate-daily-controller
description: §18.1 Daily Controller: schedule → quota gate → trigger discovery + error sweep via webhooks. Downstream failures never cascade (onError continue).

nodes.name: schedule-daily
nodes.notes: Daily trigger 06:00 Asia/Kolkata. NOTE: n8n evaluates cron in the instance timezone — the VM/n8n TZ env must be Asia/Kolkata (spec §2).

nodes.name: check-quota
nodes.notes: Quota/pause gate (§15, §20, §22). Skips the run when DAILY_PAUSED=true. Monthly budget enforcement is TODO until usage accounting is month-scoped.

nodes.name: quota-ok
nodes.notes: True: run today's pipeline. False: skip quietly and log.

nodes.name: trigger-discovery
nodes.notes: Triggers product discovery (§18.2). onError=continue so a discovery failure never cascades into the error sweep (§18: independence).

nodes.name: trigger-error-sweep
nodes.notes: Triggers the error-recovery sweep (§18.15, §20) for failed jobs. Independent of discovery — runs even if discovery failed.

nodes.name: log-run
nodes.notes: Structured run log (§19: workflow execution logs).

nodes.name: log-skipped
nodes.notes: Logs skipped days (paused or quota) — never silently dropped.
